events.title: Riii!
events.description: Riii! from the life and DEATH of king richard iii by William Shakespeare February 25 – 28 This 90-minute thrill ride is the true(ish) story of Shakespeare’s twisted usurper hacking his way up the family tree; hell-bent for the throne. A handful of actors bring over 40 characters to life (and death) in one of history’s most sensational bloodbaths: trust no one, watch your back, and hold on. Tickets will go on sale in February
events.location: St. John’s Episcopal Church 321 West Chestnut St. Lancaster, PA 17603 (Entrance for box office is off North Mulberry St)
